_comment: The vocabulary of the `inverters` field of the Home Assistant integration's GET /api/svitgrid/island/status (edge island plan, Task 35). Each inverter reports {host, writableActions, modes}. host is one of `hosts`; writableActions names custom action types from `actionTypes`; modes names writing modes from `writingModes`. `brandKinds` is what each value of the integration's brand_kind (Task 13) advertises; for `priority`, an inverter lists only the thresholds action of its own protocol. The integration vendors this file as tests/fixtures/island_capability_vocab.json. Pinned by apps/mobile/test/features/calendar/data/island_custom_capabilities_test.dart.
